finalText:
**Found it, and it's one cause, not a stacking bug.**

`engine.js` rounded the running total to US cents right after the percent coupon, before changing currency. That rounded-away fraction then got multiplied by the exchange rate, which grew it enough to tip the final rounding the wrong way.

Why it looked random: it only shows up when the rate is unkind. GBP, CAD and JPY carts drifted a cent. USD and EUR happened to round the same either way, so they looked fine.

Percent coupons alone were already wrong. Stacking just made it more visible, since more carts land near a boundary.

I removed the two mid-way roundings, so the total now rounds once at the end in the cart's own currency. All 40 tests pass in 86ms.
